title: Utility Enrollment, Supply Start and Contract End Date - C&I
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: from execution to supply.

1. An executed contract is submitted to the utility only after any required security deposit has been posted, where the structure makes a required deposit due before enrollment; every Beacon Ridge C&I structure does.
2. The utility then accepts the enrollment, recording the utility confirmation date, or rejects it.
3. Supply begins on the switch meter read date, which becomes the service start date and the term start date. The contract end date is the day before the same calendar day the term's number of calendar months after the term start date, using the last day of the month when that day does not exist.
4. A rejected contract ends without any termination fee, and its deposit is refunded.

## Contract end date worked through (hypothetical dates)

| Term start date | Term | Same calendar day that many months later | Contract end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 February 2026 | 12 months | 1 February 2027 | 31 January 2027 |
| 15 July 2026 | 24 months | 15 July 2028 | 14 July 2028 |
| 9 October 2026 | 36 months | 9 October 2029 | 8 October 2029 |

## Course of the records on one contract

- An enrollment that proceeds: the contract is executed and stands in pending enrollment; a required deposit is posted; the enrollment is submitted to the utility; the utility confirmation date is recorded; on the switch meter read date the service start date and term start date are set and the contract becomes active.
- An enrollment the utility rejects: the contract becomes rejected, carries no termination fee, and its deposit is refunded.

## Points of judgement

- A contract whose required deposit has not been posted has not been submitted to the utility.
- The term start date of a first term is the same day as the service start date.
